Not done yet......
One more time!
Let's press the attack all at once!

Great work, Captain! That was excellent command!
However, the case still isn't resolved.
Let's head straight to the next investigation!

By making good use of status effects,
you can gain the upper hand in battle!
Some enemies will use a "Charge Attack" that Guard has no effect against.
You can stop a "Charge Attack" by dealing a certain amount of damage to the enemy before it attacks.
Cards that continue a Link Combo have a glowing frame. Let's use the glowing "Red Card" in your hand!
The ability granted to a "Badge" is random.
We've found the rampaging Workloid from the report! Captain! Please give me instructions using "Cards"!
Using "Cards" of the same color in a row creates a "Link Combo", which deepens the Link between us! Let's give it a try.
Performing a "Link Combo" deepened our Link, and the "Link Gauge" has filled up!
Next, let's try using a special "Wild Card" that connects with any color!

Captain! Please wait!
Heading out to investigate with your current equipment is dangerous.
Please take a look here! This "Recommended Combat Power" represents the strength of the enemies you'll face in this case.
And this "Combat Power" here represents how strong we Buddies are.
If our "Combat Power" is lower than the "Recommended Combat Power", the enemy's strength increases significantly. At this rate, we might lose...
So! Let's head to the Shop right now and get some new "Cards"!
Spinning the "Gacha" lets you get "Cards"! Spin it a lot and get some strong cards!
What's more! Spinning the "Pickup Gacha" will also give you "Buddy Gacha Tickets"! Makes you want to spin it a lot, doesn't it!
Alright, let's go ahead and add the "Cards" you got into your "Deck"!

Great work on your first mission, Captain! You really are amazing...!
Just like during training, your sound judgment never wavered, and you solved the case brilliantly!
(...Still, who could be hacking the Workloids like this... What's really happening in this city...?)

I'm sorry... we failed, didn't we.
But we were so close!
Captain! At the scene of the last case, we found an "Enhancement Part", didn't we?

Strengthening the card made us a bit stronger!
Looks like we'll manage the next investigation!
You just got a "Card", right? Now let's "Synthesize" cards to make an even more powerful one!
Synthesizing cards to "Grade Up" raises the card's "Stats"!
By repeating "Synthesis", raise the card's "Grade" and make it stronger!
Also, low-grade cards can all be Grade Upped at once using "Quick Synthesis". How convenient!
Alright, let's try out "Quick Synthesis"!
The Hangar has been unlocked, so now you can change or strengthen us "Buddies". Let's go check it out right away!
First, let me show you how to "Train" us Buddies.
Unfortunately, I'm the only one deployed right now... so please try "Training" me this time!

Captain! Thank you
for leveling me up!
In the Hangar, you can also spend Buddy Cores to "Tune Up" a Buddy or "Request Recruitment", besides just leveling up!
You can get Buddy Cores from the "Buddy Gacha", the "Season Pass", and more!
Captain! To help keep the city safe, let's go on "Patrol"!
"Patrol" rewards accumulate over time, up to a maximum of 12 hours' worth. Leave the city's safety to us!
By using "Quick Patrol" and spending Stamina, you can also get rewards right away!
What's more, as you solve "Cases", the amount of rewards you get will keep increasing. Let's do our best!
By using "Quick Patrol" and spending Stamina, you can also get rewards right away!
Alright then! Let's head back to "Home" for now!
You've also been granted access to the "Lab"! I'll explain the details once you visit it!
Welcome to the Lab! Here, you can "Update" your Buddies and make them stronger!
Thank you for the update! Updates apply to "All Buddies". What a great deal!
You've been granted access to the "Case Files". Now you can go investigate all kinds of cases. Let's check it out right away!
Welcome to the "Case Files"! Here, you can take on all sorts of "Cases"!
Right now, you have access to Case Files related to "Robbery Pursuit", "Smuggling Crackdown", and "Regular Patrol"...
Each one lets you earn rewards like those shown above! You can challenge each "once per day", so let's take them on every day! Please give them a try!
Please take these on proactively!
Captain! Now "Missions" have been unlocked, so let's go check them out!
With the "Login Bonus", you can get rewards every day.

Completing a Mission
lets you receive a reward.
Let's check in on them often!
Earning "Daily Points" lets you receive rewards.
That's all for this explanation! Let's head back to "Home"!
Captain! You've been cleared to deploy to "Special Investigation" and "Dedicated Investigation"!
For "Special Investigation" and "Dedicated Investigation", solving a case unlocks a new difficulty level and adds special rules.
First, let's try taking on "Special Investigation"!
It's more difficult and dangerous than any case so far... but if you can solve it, you'll get two "Special Training Materials".
Make sure to prepare thoroughly before taking on "Special Investigation" and "Dedicated Investigation". ...I can't wait!

As the difficulty rises,
more special rules get added.
Also, "Dedicated Investigation", where you take on the challenge with a designated Buddy, has been unlocked as well.
That's all for this explanation! Let's head back to "Home"!
Captain, at last, the place to test our strength... You've been cleared to deploy to the "Extreme Trial"!
In the "Extreme Trial", you take on a special case and compete for score against other squads. Choose your "Risk" and aim for an even higher score!

You'll also face a large number of enemies,
so let's manage the fight carefully!
In the Extreme Trial, the more you fill the "Risk Gauge", the higher a score you can aim for! This is where you get to show off your skill, Captain.

If you manage to place near the top of the rankings,
you can earn a special reward!
Let's do our best not to lose to the other squads!

There's also a ranking system,
where you compete for placement against 100 people in the same tier!

The higher the tier, the more lavish the rewards!
Let's aim for the top!
You can get Cards from the "Gacha". Let's go check it out!
Clearing either one gets you "Lab Chips" usable in the Lab!
Please take these on proactively!
You can deploy up to 3 times a day, and clearing it can sometimes earn you a "Badge"!
Let's go ahead and give it a try!
Equipping complete! You can equip up to "5 Badges" at once. 　The higher the class you aim for in the Extreme Trial, the easier it is to obtain "powerful Badges".
Badges you don't use can be sold and converted into Credits. "Auto-Sell feature" is also available, so be sure to make use of it!

The higher the rarity of a Badge,
the more abilities and higher effects it has!
Unneeded "Badges" can be sold and converted into "Credits"!
Please! Make good use of your "Badges"!
Let's give it another try!

Now then, let's head off to investigate the next case.
I'll show you just how strong I've become!
The upgrade went through safely!
That's all for this explanation! Let's head back to "Home"!
Next, let's go check out the "Daily Missions"!
Using an "Enhancement Part" lets you strengthen a "Card"! Let's give it a try right away!
By adding the card to your Deck, your "Combat Power" is now above the "Recommended Combat Power"!

Alright, we're all set!
Captain! Let's deploy!
You've added the card to your Deck! If it's not in the Deck, "you can't use it in battle", so please be careful, Captain!

...thi–...is BR...1G, ......ing you.
...Yes! ...Yes, unders–...–d!

Destinatio-...-hanged, ETA approx... 10 minu-...-s.
.........head to the sc-...-e with the Captain right away!

We just received an emergency dispatch request.
We were heading to HQ, but there's no time!

We'll head straight to the scene
and begin the mission immediately!

I imagine you already know some of this, Captain,
but the city we're heading to now, "Sync City"...

Those Workloids have been hacked by someone unknown,
causing them to go on rampages and attack the city — that's the situation we're facing.

The number of rampaging Workloids grows every day,
and among them, the "Large Workloids" are especially dangerous.

Some areas have been taken over by Large Workloids
and are now off-limits.

The "R.U.S.H." unit that you, Captain, take command of starting today
is an elite squad specialized in countering Workloids.
Captain! From here on, this isn't training — it's the real thing...!
...Sorry, I got a little fired up there.

Oh, it looks like we're almost at the scene
of the reported rampaging Workloid.

That's all for this introduction! Make sure to prepare thoroughly
before deploying to your next investigation!
The Link Gauge has filled up 3 bars! Fill a 4th bar, and your "Link Level" will go up! The Link Level is maintained throughout this battle with the enemy.
If you use a "Link Card" when raising your Link Level, it triggers a powerful "Link Attack"! Let's try using one now!
The "Link Card" became more powerful, and we dealt huge damage! Let's keep using them at the right timing to gain the upper hand in battle.
Raising our "Link Level" increased our ATK, and the "RUSH Gauge" has filled up.
Filling up the "RUSH Gauge" lets us use "RUSH Mode", which unleashes us Buddies' hidden potential, so let's work hard to fill it up!
The enemy's attack is coming! Taking it head-on is dangerous. Let's "Counter" it!
If you don't "Counter", your Link Level will drop, so aim carefully!　Some powerful attacks can't be countered, so be careful.
A new enemy! It looks tough, but if we use "RUSH Mode", we can definitely beat it!　Let's start by filling the Link Gauge.
Captain! This is our trump card for taking down a powerful enemy... Let's finish it in one go with "RUSH Mode"! This time, you can use some specially supplied energy.
RUSH Mode, online! Now we can use "RUSH Mode"!
While in "RUSH Mode", our hidden potential is unleashed, and our ATK goes up!

We can't just sit here, Captain...!
A dispatch request has already come in from the next scene!
Captain!!
You won't... abandon me, right...?

S-sorry!
I just really wanted to be of help to you, Captain!

Please don't worry!
I, Aile, will do my best to be useful!

So please, once we arrive at the scene,
don't take your eyes off me, okay?
Captain! Are you hurt anywhere?
Face... okay... hands... okay...
Your hand, Captain... it's warm...

Um... today......
can I keep holding it...?

Outta my waaay! Move it, move it!
Ain't nobody gonna stop me!
Bam!
Owww! Watch where you're lookin'!

Wait, ain't you my partner!
Can't believe you actually stopped me...

Wait, that's wrong!
I'm the one who crashed into you!

Ugh! Forget it!
Let's just move and clear my head!

Hey! Partner!
This patrol's my apology for the crash! Let's go!
Alright! Patrol complete!

Hey! Partner!
You're not hurt or anything, right?
Me? This is just a scratch...
Hyaaah!?

Hey! Where are you touching!
Do that again and I'll knock you out!

This is sudden, Captain,
but what do you think of my body?
Ah, if you're interested, go ahead and touch it.

Feels good, doesn't it?
I train every single day.

...I said you could touch it,
but your hands are getting a bit fresh.

So you like it that much, huh?
Hahaha! Well, I'm glad.

Guess it's time to show you the results of my training.
Let's go!
Gooot・you♡

We're almost there,
so don't space out on me, okay?

You might get caught by a naughty Workloid
and get all messed up~

Or・may・be♡
you'd rather I mess you up instead?
Just kidding~ Did you get your hopes up?

But if you work reeeally hard on this mission,
I just might give you a little reward♡
Do your best, okay? Dar・ling♡
Mini's gonna put handcuffs on you, Master.

'Cause Master's totally weak,
and you'd just wander off on your own.

So you don't get lost,
Mini will keep you managed.

Master of the Master...
heh, kinda cool, actually.
Huh? You're saying the handcuffs are more dangerous?

Then on this mission,
show Mini that you're a grown-up.

...has "Workloids," so-called "helper robots,"
built into the very foundation of daily life.
If you look away... no-no, that's a no-no!
How's that! That's the result of my training!

With a body this well-trained,
I can protect you from any threat.
What's that? You're too tired to walk?

Can't be helped.
I'll carry you home myself.

Hey! Quit squirming!
You're not a baby!

And, done♡
You did so well~

Hmm~? A reward?
What could that have been about~

Ehehe, just kidding.
I have to give something to the one who worked so hard.
Come here.

I'll spoil you rotten,
I・prom・ise♡
Master's orders were really good.

...Annoying, but Mini will admit it.
Master really is a grown-up.

Don't get the wrong idea.
Mini's still stronger.
Next time, Mini will take the lead.

From here on, let's fight freely.
I'll follow your orders, Captain!
Plus, a powerful "Exclusive Card" usable only during RUSH Mode will be added to the deck! Use it well and defeat the enemy!
You can select an "Enhancement Program" that helps in battle! It's hard to decide which one to pick.

Not done yet......
One more time!
Let's press the attack all at once!

...With you, Captain, I feel like we can solve any case.
Once again, I look forward to working with you...!

...Captain! Captain!
Sorry to wake you...!

I'm sorry things are so hectic on your very first day...!
HQ just sent over the case details, so let me fill you in!

...Our mission is to subdue these Workloids
and protect this city as members of the police.

Let's subdue the rampaging Workloids together
and bring peace back to Sync City!!

Once we arrive, we'll be in combat with the Workloid right away!
Captain, I'll be counting on your orders...!!
